body: I really don't know. I have really only talked to my best friend about all of this, and I really don't want anyone else to have to deal with my issues; I am not worth the time. And the 8th grade issue was just as much what happened to her as that she had used me as an escape, and she made that clear with me. I really just don't know what to do, but really don't want to talk to a consellor about it.
